entities.name: Mehtma
entities.description: A krumar lieutenant of House Fenzala in Qatros Karst who teaches the house's youths while longing for a posting under Khan Felothar, and who ends the story as captain of logistics.

entities.name: Vauti
entities.description: Mehtma's loxodon aide, who brings her coffee and helps her in the rescue and the aftermath.

entities.name: Jurjis
entities.description: The smug captain of logistics of House Agach, who requisitions Mehtma's cows, hoards supplies and conspires with the Sultai to steal a cutting of House Fenzala's Kin-Tree.

entities.name: Cemil
entities.description: A krumar warden's assistant of House Fenzala who proves to be a Sultai agent and helps Jurjis reach the Kin-Tree chamber.

entities.name: Enti
entities.description: A young loxodon in Mehtma's cohort who is killed protecting the Kin-Tree and then manifests as a spirit that aids Mehtma.

entities.name: Gohl
entities.description: A horned orc youth in Mehtma's cohort, trapped in the rubble after the barrage and rescued by Mehtma.

entities.name: Councilor Dvujin
entities.description: An anxious bureaucrat of the Qatros Karst council whom Mehtma pressures into making her captain of logistics.

entities.name: Khan Felothar
entities.description: The young khan of the Abzan, whom Mehtma longs to serve and who is cut off from true reports of the siege.

entities.name: Dromoka
entities.description: A dragon-tyrant whose monsters the Abzan rebelled against and who forced krumar upon the houses and sundered the Kin-Trees.

entities.name: Anafenza
entities.description: The owner of a secret grove from which the cutting for House Fenzala's Kin-Tree was brought.

entities.name: Qatros Karst
entities.description: A grand Abzan haven carved into rock, born from humble refugee caves, now besieged by the Sultai.

entities.name: Great Arashin
entities.description: The place where Jurjis claims to have been born.

entities.name: House Fenzala
entities.description: An Abzan house of Qatros Karst, favored by the khan, that grows a young Kin-Tree and adopts krumar orphans.

entities.name: House Agach
entities.description: An Abzan house without a Kin-Tree, to which Jurjis belongs.

entities.name: Abzan
entities.description: The clan of Tarkir whose houses and Kin-Trees bind ancestors and descendants; its militia defends Qatros Karst.

entities.name: Sultai
entities.description: A necromantic clan besieging Qatros Karst and demanding mining rights.

entities.name: Kin-Tree
entities.description: A sacred tree that binds an Abzan house to its ancestors, whose spirits flower into it; House Fenzala's is young and was planted two years earlier.

entities.name: Krumar
entities.description: Orphans adopted into Abzan houses, who Cemil and Jurjis claim are never seen as truly Abzan.

entities.name: Siege of Qatros Karst
entities.description: The Sultai siege of Qatros Karst, with artillery and necromancy causing hunger and ruin.

events.summary: Mehtma leads her seven charges, including Enti and Gohl, into the Kin-Tree chamber to be accepted into House Fenzala as adults.
events.quote: Today the Kin-Tree will accept you into our house with the full honors and responsibilities of an adult.

events.summary: Mehtma, resentful of teaching during the siege, watches Cemil on duty in the chamber and recalls wanting to serve Khan Felothar.
events.quote: Mehtma was ready to make a name for herself, to see Abzan in all its glory, to serve Khan Felothar.

events.summary: Vauti brings Mehtma's rationed coffee but no cream, because the militia has blockaded the stables.
events.quote: Our stables have been blockaded by the militia.

events.summary: Mehtma confronts Jurjis, who is requisitioning her cows as unreported and claims there is no permit on file.
events.quote: I am requisitioning these unreported cows.

events.summary: Mehtma learns that Sultai necromancy reached the arena district and that Jurjis controls all supply through his office.
events.quote: Last night, Sultai necromancy reached all the way into the arena district,

events.summary: A Sultai artillery barrage punches through the city's ceiling, killing the clerks and wrecking the old marketplace.
events.quote: All three clerks were dead, one scarcely more than a smear of blood and flesh where the artillery stone had made its initial impact.

events.summary: Mehtma and Vauti rally onlookers to lift a fallen beam and Mehtma crawls beneath it to reach three trapped youths including Gohl.
events.quote: The beam precariously balanced above her, she shimmied in,

events.summary: Mehtma drags one youth out just before Vauti lets the beam drop, and tells Gohl to take charge of the others.
events.quote: Vauti bugled, and the beam dropped with a heavy thud.

events.summary: Mehtma glimpses her cows being led by Cemil and chases him to the east gate, finding the guard posts empty and the gate ajar.
events.quote: Her cows, in the distance, passing through one of those spears of sunlight, being led by Cemil .

events.summary: Cemil flees toward the outer gate and Mehtma races up to the top of the wall to cut him off.
events.quote: Cemil dropped the cows' lead and bolted into the darkness, up the enclosed ramp, toward the outer gate.

events.summary: On the ramparts Cemil attacks Mehtma with a Sultai sickle and she overpowers and disarms him.
events.quote: She swept a foot against the back of his knee, brought him sprawling down, and wrenched the blade out of his hands.

events.summary: Cemil says krumar will never be seen as truly Abzan and that he was never House Fenzala but Sultai.
events.quote: "I was never House Fenzala," he said. "I am Sultai."

events.summary: Cemil reveals the deal he made with Jurjis and flings himself off the battlements into the Sultai fog, dragging Mehtma until he lets go and falls.
events.quote: he let go of her wrist and fell into the mist.

events.summary: Mehtma realizes the cow ruse was a distraction so that Cemil's passphrase could get House Agach into the Kin-Tree chamber.
events.quote: Which Cemil, assistant to the warden, had. The betrayal was unthinkable.

events.summary: Mehtma finds the sanctum open and Jurjis kneeling by the body of young Enti.
events.quote: The body was young Enti, the little loxodon who always had a question.

events.summary: Jurjis declares that he will take a cutting of the Kin-Tree because his house has been refused one, and the two fight.
events.quote: But my house has been refused a Kin-Tree for too long.

events.summary: Jurjis wounds Mehtma and, axe raised, threatens to chop down the Kin-Tree.
events.quote: I was only going to take a cutting, but now I'll let you see me chop it down,

events.summary: Enti's ancestor-spirit steps out of the Kin-Tree in golden armor and lends Mehtma strength.
events.quote: A glowing gold figure stepped out of the tree, a loxodon in gleaming armor,

events.summary: Mehtma drives Jurjis back and kills him with Cemil's Sultai sickle.
events.quote: Jurjis collapsed face down, dead.

events.summary: Enti's spirit vanishes and a single bud opens into a sun-bright flower in the Kin-Tree.
events.quote: Within the canopy, a single bud had opened into a delicate sun-bright flower.

events.summary: Mehtma and Councilor Dvujin search Jurjis's office and find the letters to the khan never sent.
events.quote: These were never sent.

events.summary: Mehtma persuades Dvujin to appoint her captain of logistics in exchange for burying Jurjis's corruption.
events.quote: Appoint me captain of logistics, and I'll make Jurjis's corruption and collusion with the Sultai

events.summary: Now addressed as Captain, Mehtma drinks her coffee with cream.
events.quote: "As you requested, Captain."

relations.quote: orphans adopted into House Fenzala as Mehtma herself had been.
Her loxodon aide Vauti opened the door bearing her morning coffee tray.

relations.note: rival for captain of logistics who takes her cows and attacks her
relations.quote: When you tried to take my place as acting captain of logistics?

relations.note: House Agach's officer who wants a Kin-Tree for his house
relations.quote: House Agach didn't even have a Kin-Tree!

relations.note: reveals he is Sultai and made a deal with Jurjis
relations.quote: "I was never House Fenzala," he said. "I am Sultai."

relations.note: made a deal with Jurjis to distract Mehtma
relations.quote: This is the deal I made with Jurjis.

relations.note: found kneeling over the body with a knife
relations.quote: An armored man wearing the face of another house knelt next to a prone body, a heavy knife in his hand.

relations.note: besieging Qatros Karst and demanding mining rights
relations.quote: The real sticking point was the Sultai's demand for mining rights,

relations.note: Mehtma fought in the rebellion against Dromoka's monsters
relations.quote: the battle had been against Dromoka's monsters.
